response.sql: WITH mt AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS cnt FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avgr AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM mt), f AS (SELECT mt.rate, mt.cnt, avgr.a FROM mt, avgr WHERE mt.rate > avgr.a) SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(rate - a) AS avg_excess FROM f
